notes.title: Layback Spins + Mega Cup Update
notes.notes:
What's new?

The Mega Cup: the toughest and longest competition yet, with new leaderboard.

Layback spins are now available.

New ice rink visuals for a fresh look.

A Faster Jumps mode that lets you execute jumps more quickly.

New achievements to unlock.

notes.title: New Animations & Graphics Update – What’s New?
notes.notes:
New Animations & Graphics Update – What’s New?
A fresh update is here to level up your experience! Here’s what’s included:

Enhanced color graphics for a refreshed visual style

New spins and poses to show off your moves

New character skins to customize your look

Updated component animations

Redesigned scoreboard UI with a new menu

Camera now zooms dynamically during jumps and spins

Optional fog and particle effects – turn on them in settings for the perfect atmosphere

Thanks for playing – and stay tuned, more exciting features are on the way!

notes.title: Multiplayer Update!
notes.notes:
Multiplayer Update!
What’s new in this update?
[olist]
Multiplayer Mode – Play with others! Join either the men’s or women’s room and compete with your friends. Please note: this feature is in Beta, so bugs may occur.

New Scoreboard UI – Enjoy an improved scoreboard design for better tracking and competition!
[/olist]
Thanks for playing—stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Workshop + Jump Declaration Update
notes.notes:
Workshop & Jump Declaration Update – What’s New:

[olist]
     Steam Workshop Integration
   Share your favorite skating music with the community! You can now upload your own tracks and download music shared by others directly via the Steam Workshop.
     Jump Declaration Feature
    Plan your routine like a pro—enable the optional Jump Declaration to pre-select your jumps in order before starting your program.
     Expanded Customization Options
  Enjoy even more creativity with the ability to design your own custom colors for a unique look on the ice.
     Additional Features

       More custom music slots
      New component animations
       Additional outfits for skaters

     Bug Fixes
     Various bugs have been addressed to improve your overall experience.
[/olist]

notes.title: Custom inputs + Quick bug fix
notes.notes:
Custom inputs + Quick bug fix
I originally planned to release this update in mid-May, but I ran into an unusual bug where jump combinations in the second part of the program were giving a higher base value than intended. This issue has now been fixed, and scores should display correctly. I've also added button for custom keyboard inputs and included a detailed breakdown of technical elements.

notes.title: Euler Jump Update!
notes.notes:
Euler Jump Update!
Here’s what’s new:

[olist]
     Euler Jump Added – Replay the tutorial to learn how to do it!
     New Menu Look – Updated design with interactive buttons.
     Adjusted Scoring – Component scoring has been rebalanced.
     "Jumps" Challenge – Earn extra XP by landing difficult jumps in competitions!
     Training Mode Option – Choose to use energy, just like in real competitions.
     Tips Book – Find useful tips in the main menu to improve your score.
[/olist]

Thanks for playing! Suggestions are always welcome!

notes.title: Score Announcement & Podium Update
notes.notes:
Score Announcement & Podium Update – What’s New?

[olist]
     Real-time score announcements now include skaters' reactions.
     Podium ceremony added if the combined score ranks in the top 3.
     More slots available for custom textures.
     An extra slot added for custom music.
[/olist]
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: 2025 World Championships Update!
notes.notes:
World Championships 2025 Update!

What's new in this update?
[olist]
     World 2025 Challenge – Take on the new test of skill! 
     New WHITE Components & Enhanced Animations – Elevate your skating program with unique elements and an improved Components Designer UI.
     Expanded Customization – More animations, colors, and spin options for a personalized experience.
     Revamped Audience Design – A fresh look for a more immersive atmosphere.
     Redesigned UI for Spins & Step/Choreo Sequences – Improved score display for better tracking.
     New Sound Indicators – Audio cues now signal the level achieved for each element.
     Hands-Up Jumps! – Now you can perform jumps with your hands up! Simply hold Right Shift in the air, or if using a joystick, hold the right joystick up!
[/olist]

Thank you for playing—stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Custom Spins/Step/Choreo Sequences Update!
notes.notes:
What's new in this update?

     Create custom camel, sit, and combo spins!
     Design your own step and choreo sequences.
     Added an XP reset button to fix an XP bug that caused values to become NaN. The bug is now fixed, but if your XP is still NaN, you can reset it to 0 to continue progressing.


[previewyoutube=h66YoUXb0Uo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for playing! Next update coming soon—just in time for the World Championships!

notes.title: Custom Music & Texture Update + Four Continents
notes.notes:
What's New in This Update?
[olist]
     Circular Rotation Chart – A new chart displaying the current rotation is now available. You can toggle it on or off in the settings menu.
     Custom Music for Free Skating & Short Program – Upload your own music in MP3 or WAV format and set custom jump timers to match your routine.
     Custom Textures and more Colors – Personalize your skater by uploading PNG, JPEG, or JPG images in the texture menu.
     Enhanced Animations & Costumes – More component animations and additional costume options have been added.
     Four Continents Special Event – A new event has been introduced for the Four Continents competition.
[/olist]

Thank you for playing! Stay tuned for the next major update before the World Championships.

notes.title: 2025 European Championships Update!
notes.notes:
Celebrate the European Championships with a brand-new challenge!
     New Features & Improvements:
[olist]
         Added a Musical Jump Timer to track the time until the next musical jump.
         Adjusted scoring for Local Division, Grand Prix, and World Championships.
         Introduced components in Training Mode for a more complete practice experience.
         Fixed spin-related bugs for smoother gameplay.
[/olist]

Enjoy the update and keep aiming for the top!

notes.title: Launch Update
notes.notes: Simplified the scoring for the Beginners and Local divisions, resulting in lower opponent scores.
